scripts.build: npm run build -w uplus-icon && npm run build -w uplus-icon-site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w uplus-icon && npm run typecheck -w uplus-icon-site
scripts.check:generated: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/icons/src/generated packages/icons/src/icons
scripts.check:raw: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/icons/raw
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:package -w uplus-icon && npm run test:fidelity -w uplus-icon && npm run test:size -w uplus-icon && npm run test:consumer -w uplus-icon && npm run check:generated && npm run check:raw
